summary: InMode Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 20, 2026, announcing the appointment of Dr. Shlomo Nass as a new independent director and Chairman, and Moshe (Moshik) Itzkovich as CFO effective May 19, 2026, following the prior CFO's transition to a consultant role. The board filled the vacancy left by the earlier departure of Dr. Michael Anghel. Dr. Nass will serve as Chairman of the Board and of the Audit Investment Committee, and will receive standard director compensation. Mr. Itzkovich receives a CAD 500k base salary plus discretionary bonus. The appointments are described as not pursuant to any arrangement, and no related-party transactions were disclosed. These are routine director and CFO changes without forced departure dynamics, so the category is Management Changes with medium intensity.
